questions.prompt: A built-in Azure Monitor backup failure alert for vault-a appears in the portal. The on-call email action group works in its test. The enabled Add action groups processing rule covers only vault-b, its filters otherwise match, and no suppression applies. What should you change to route future matching vault-a alerts to that team?

options.explanation: Recovery-point retention does not change the processing rule’s alert-resource scope.

options.text: Change only the notification action group’s display name.
options.explanation: Renaming the group does not cause the rule scoped to vault-b to process vault-a alerts.

options.text: Enable backup job-failure alert generation again on vault-a without changing the rule.
options.explanation: The alert already exists; generation does not correct the mismatched notification scope.

options.text: Include vault-a in a supported processing-rule scope that applies the on-call action group.
options.explanation: The missing vault scope prevents routing; covering vault-a lets the matching rule apply the tested email action group.

questions.prompt: You suppress Azure Backup alert actions during planned maintenance using an alert processing rule. What does this accomplish?

options.text: Suppresses matching notifications/actions without repairing backup failures.
options.explanation: Processing rules govern actions; the underlying backup job and alert condition remain separate.

options.text: Automatically retries every failed backup until successful.
options.explanation: An action-suppression rule does not implement backup retry.

options.text: Deletes failed-job records and their alerts permanently.
options.explanation: Suppressing actions does not delete the underlying alert/job history.

options.text: Disables the backup policy's scheduled jobs.
options.explanation: Alert-action processing does not change the backup schedule.

questions.prompt: A custom backup log-alert query will run against ws-alerts. Vault-a currently exports the required job diagnostics only to ws-reports. You need future vault-a job records available to that query while preserving export to ws-reports. Which collection change meets the goal?

options.text: Keep the current export unchanged and create an action group for ws-alerts.
options.explanation: An action group supplies responses, not ingestion of the missing vault records into the queried workspace.

options.text: Add a separate diagnostic setting exporting the required vault-a logs to ws-alerts.
options.explanation: This supplies the records to the query’s workspace while the existing setting continues its ws-reports export.

options.text: Keep the current export unchanged and increase ws-alerts retention.
options.explanation: Retention preserves ingested records longer; it cannot ingest records exported only to ws-reports.

options.text: Replace the current setting’s destination with ws-alerts and remove ws-reports export.
options.explanation: This supplies ws-alerts but violates the requirement to preserve the existing ws-reports export.
